summary: Mitchell Dale Stehling, 51, of Goliad TX, set out ~4:30pm on a short hike to Spruce Tree House at Mesa Verde NP with his wife and parents; veered onto the Petroglyph Point Trail and never returned. An intensive two-week search peaked at 60-70 searchers plus scent-dog teams. His remains were found 2020-09-17 after an anonymous tip, ~4.2 mi from where last seen in a remote canyon; presumptively identified by personal items (driver's license, credit cards, Social Security card); no foul play suspected, cause of death not determinable from skeletal remains.
location: Spruce Tree House / Petroglyph Point Trail, Mesa Verde National Park
responding_agency: National Park Service; Montezuma County Coroner's Office
notes: Anon tip 2020-09-16; remains found 2020-09-17 in an area searched in 2013. Coroner George Deavers '99%' sure of ID; DNA analysis planned. Day of disappearance exceeded 100 degF; subject carried no water. NPS morning-report compendium (meve.htm, 2020-09-23 follow-up) confirms remains believed to be Stehling, found 2020-09-17 (Thursday-verified) after an anonymous tip; cause of death not determined.
